guide: Open Start here and type your agency name and targets in the yellow cells: reply hours, stale days, days to start, target margin and payroll burden (payroll taxes, workers' insurance and benefits on top of pay; confirm with your adviser).

Check Rate Card, Services, Areas and Payers. A caregiver is a carer, care worker or support worker. The holiday rate applies on a holiday (a bank holiday or another public holiday); private pay means self-funded.

Log every enquiry on Enquiry Log with its source, hours and hours to first reply. The quote, days to start, reply check and stale flag fill in. An open enquiry is a stale enquiry when it has had no contact for more days than your limit.
Record each call on Enquiry Calls, each assessment on Assessments (service needs and hours only, never care notes), each quote on Quotes and each agreement on Service Agreements.
Use Can I Take This Client? before you say yes: it checks caregiver free hours without overtime (hours above the weekly line) and the margin at your quoted rate.
Use Minimum Rate for Target, Rate Card Margin Checker and Rate Card Builder to set rates; Quote Builder and Quote Sensitivity to price one client; Deposit and Prepayment to size a deposit.

Review Monthly Funnel, Lost Enquiries and Source by Month every month; Source Value Ranking shows the source to grow. A third-party payer is an insurer, a public body or an employer scheme in your area.
A one-person start-up agency can use Enquiries, Quotes, Agreements and the One-Person Capacity Check from day one; it needs no caregiver list.
Replace the demo data: clear the sample rows, keep the headers, type your own rows and your own targets. The workbook has no macros and works in Excel and Google Sheets.
Use the 18 decision tools: each ends with a verdict and a what-if table. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready messages.

Why a workbook: one flat price, no per-client or per-caregiver fee, no price rise when hours grow, and your data stays with you. It does not track visits live, use GPS or check in automatically; it works from the times you type or paste.

listing.title: Home Care Agency Excel Template: Enquiry Log, Quotes, Service Agreements, Rate Card Margin, Funnel and Can I Take This Client Tool
listing.headline: Win more clients and price every quote above your margin, in one Excel file
listing.description:
Run everything between the first call and the first visit of a non-medical home care agency in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-director with a scheduler, an office manager and field supervisors, and simple enough for a one-person start-up agency.

The Enquiry Log records every enquiry with its source, service, hours wanted, hours to first reply, assessment, agreement and first visit, then works out days to start and flags a stale enquiry against targets you set. Assessments, Quotes, Service Agreements, Enquiry Calls, Lost Enquiries (by reason), Source by Month and the Monthly Funnel follow every person to the first visit. The Rate Card holds 30 rates by service and time band with the margin per hour, the Rate History records every rise, and Caregiver Capacity and Availability show free hours next week.

18 decision tools answer weekly questions with a verdict and a what-if table: Can I take this client?, minimum rate for the target margin, rate card margin checker, quote builder, deposit sizing, short-visit surcharge, reply speed, funnel conversion, source value ranking, time to start, price test, hours to fill forecast and a one-person capacity check. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents including the service agreement, quote letter and price list, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready messages.

This is part one of the Home Care Agency Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, one flat price with no per-client fee, your data stays with you, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data. The workbook holds service types, hours, dates and amounts only; it is not a care plan, tracks nothing live and promises no results.

documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Welcome letter for a new client
paragraphs: Welcome letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:clients.client},

Thank you for choosing us. Your first visit is on {col:clients.start_date}, with {col:clients.preferred}; your second caregiver is {col:clients.preferred_2}. An introduction visit comes first on {col:clients.intro_on}.
Our office is open during office hours. To change a visit, call {col:clients.scheduler_name} on {col:clients.scheduler_phone}. Your field supervisor is {col:clients.supervisor_name}.
Your agreement is for {col:clients.weekly_hours} hours a week of {col:clients.service}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Deposit receipt
paragraphs: Deposit receipt of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client {col:clients.client_id}: {col:clients.client}.
We received a deposit of {col:clients.deposit}, about {col:clients.deposit_weeks} weeks of your hours, before your first visit on {col:clients.start_date}.
The deposit is held until your agreement ends and is returned or applied to the last invoice. Agree the details with the office manager, {col:clients.manager_name}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Rate change notice
paragraphs: Rate change notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:clients.client},
Your rate for {col:clients.service} is now {col:clients.bill_rate} per hour. From {col:clients.rate_change_on} the rate will be {col:clients.new_rate} per hour, before any tax.
We give {set:rate_notice_days} days of written notice. Your weekly hours stay at {col:clients.weekly_hours}. Please contact {col:clients.scheduler_name} with any question.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Cancellation terms for one agreement
paragraphs: Cancellation and notice terms of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:agreements.client}. Agreement {col:agreements.agreement_id}.

Please give at least {col:agreements.notice_days} days of notice to cancel or move a visit. With less notice we may charge up to the minimum visit of {col:agreements.min_visit_hours} hours, {col:agreements.min_visit_charge}.
A caregiver who cannot come will be replaced by another caregiver where we can; we will tell you as soon as we know. Check your own local rules for what you may charge.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Start of care confirmation
paragraphs: Start of care confirmation of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:clients.client},
Your first visit is on {col:clients.start_date}. Your caregiver is {col:clients.preferred}. The visit is in the {col:clients.area} area for {col:clients.service}.
Your introduction visit is on {col:clients.intro_on}. Your field supervisor is {col:clients.supervisor_name}, phone {col:clients.supervisor_phone}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Enquiry reply letter
paragraphs: Reply of {set:company}, dated {today}. Dear {col:enquiries.name},
Thank you for your enquiry of {col:enquiries.received_on} about {col:enquiries.service} for {col:enquiries.hours_week} hours a week in {col:enquiries.area}.

We aim to reply within {set:reply_hours_target} hours. Your assessment visit is on {col:enquiries.assessment_on} with {col:enquiries.assessor}. If you have a question please call {col:enquiries.scheduler_name} on {col:enquiries.scheduler_phone}. Reference {col:enquiries.enquiry_id}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Weekly enquiry report for one month
paragraphs: Weekly enquiry report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Month starting {col:funnel.month}.

Enquiries: {col:funnel.enquiries}, about {col:funnel.enq_per_week} a week. Assessments: {col:funnel.assessments}. Agreements: {col:funnel.agreements}. Started: {col:funnel.started}. Lost: {col:funnel.lost}.
Enquiry-to-client conversion: {col:funnel.conversion}. Assessment rate: {col:funnel.assessment_rate}. Decide at the weekly meeting which open enquiries to chase first.

documents.title: Funnel and source report for one source and month
paragraphs: Source report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Month starting {col:sources.month}. Source: {col:sources.source}.
Enquiries: {col:sources.enquiries}. Clients started: {col:sources.started}. Weekly hours started: {col:sources.hours_started}. Cost: {col:sources.cost}.
Cost per client started: {col:sources.cost_per_start}. Hours started per 100 of cost over 12 months: {col:sources.value_12m}. Grow the sources with the most hours per cost and fix or cut the rest.
